Read-only execution audit; no remote writes.

```{python}
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1]);assert not out.exists()
remote=r'''
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/mnt/isilon/projects/bioinformatics_platform/projects/shared_references/scratch_archives/snarayanasamy/phage_uv_treatment_20260726_full_output/output/PRJEB79569/binning/.snakemake/metadata')
records=[]
for f in p.iterdir():
 if not f.is_file():continue
 try:d=json.loads(f.read_text())
 except (ValueError,UnicodeError):continue
 if d.get('rule') in ['get_all_prokaryotic_seqs','maxbin2','metabat2','vamb','semibin','concoct']:
  records.append({'path':str(f),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'metadata':d})
print(json.dumps(records))
'''
r=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=15','iris-cluster','python3','-'],input=remote,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
records=json.loads(r.stdout)
rows=[x['metadata'] for x in records if x['metadata']['rule']=='get_all_prokaryotic_seqs']
assert len(rows)==12
assert all(not d.get('incomplete') and d.get('endtime') for d in rows)
assert all(all(s in d['shellcmd'] for s in ['prokaryotes.fa','prokaryotic_viruses.fa','plasmids.fa']) for d in rows)
out.mkdir(parents=True);(out/'evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
print('All 12 completed input-pooling commands concatenate prokaryotic, prokaryotic-virus and plasmid contigs.')
seen=set()
for row in records:
 d=row['metadata']
 if d['rule'] not in seen:
  print(d['rule'],d['shellcmd']);seen.add(d['rule'])
```
